title: I Let the Reserved-Rower Scanner Catch the Coach Who Sat on Mine

parts.text: I scanned bay nine at 6:13 a.m. and coach Tess was already on my numbered erg. The light said RESERVED. NAME ON THE SCREEN. I was twenty-eight, member, standing in a row that made me look like I owned the wait. Tess shrugged. "Coaches are the bay." I photographed the light, the screen, and her bottle on my rail. Then I let the scanner keep the ping. Tess laughed until the desk asked for the still. The bay went back to my name. Tess reserve-dates the screen now. A light is only a light until someone treats it like a clock.

social.video_title: The reserved rower already had the coach on it — Part 1/1
social.description: Bay nine, a coach on my rail, a reserved light. The desk asked for the still. Has a booking ever sat someone else first?
